answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a long history of honest work, like a walnut tree planted at dawn that yields nothing until seasons of care pass. A new identity starts as thin as a willow shoot, able to do small tasks only; larger jobs need larger locked stake and a clean record. Creating thousands of fakes then costs thousands of stakes, and misbehaviour slashes the bond, so Sybil attacks become expensive and unprofitable.
